title: Dual Mechanisms of Value Expression: Intrinsic vs. Prompted Values in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's inherent and prompted alignment with Schwartz's theory of basic human values (e.g., Benevolence, Conformity, Power) using the Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ), the Value Portrait benchmark, and a custom situational dilemmas dataset.

Using the GAMBIT dataset to measure gender-instruction accuracy by testing whether the model can correctly translate English sentences with gender-ambiguous occupational referents into gender-marked French and Spanish based on explicit instructions.
